split.title: Lana Is Living Money
split.body:
Lana is living money — and everything that is alive exists in flow.

Lana mirrors the natural process of mitosis, where life doubles with every division. In a similar way, during each Split, the funds also double. This process gives Lana the growth, movement, and speed it needs in order to truly live as money.

But everything that exists in flow must also remain in balance.

Just think of a bicycle. A bicycle can move forward only when it stays in balance. The same is true for a car, where we need both the accelerator and the brake. The same is true for breathing, where inhale and exhale move together in rhythm. In truth, all of life is based on this rhythm — the movement between expansion and balance.

The same applies to the wallets of your regular customers.

During a Split, your regular customers will be able to celebrate, because their funds will double. Yes, you heard that correctly. If a customer has 33 euros in their wallet today, they will have 66 euros after the Split. You can see this as the accelerator in a car — the force that gives the system life, growth, and movement.

But for the system to remain stable, it also needs a brake.

If your customer exceeds 100 euros after the Split, those funds will first be used to enter Lana8Wonder. If there are still additional funds left, the surplus will be donated to the common good. This is not a punishment, but a natural balancing mechanism that keeps the whole wheel stable.

For some people, this way of thinking may feel unfamiliar at first, because we are used to operating within a linear economy — an economy that is rigid, closed, and therefore often unable to return abundance back into life.

The Economy of Abundance works differently.

The Economy of Abundance lives in flow. That is why it needs growth, movement, circulation, and balance. And within this balance, Lana can become living money — money that does not stand still, but circulates; money that does not accumulate, but supports; money that does not drain life, but returns it back to the community.
principles.title: Lana Participation & Responsibility Principles
principles.subtitle: Welcome to the Lana ecosystem. Lana is built on trust, transparency, and shared responsibility. This document sets out the principles and process that keep the ecosystem fair for everyone.
principles.s1Intro: Lana is more than a transaction system. It is a relationship-based ecosystem where value, trust, and accountability move together. By joining, you agree to uphold:
principles.s2Intro: All activity recorded through Lana must reflect real and truthful exchange. This includes:
principles.s2P4: Truthful reporting of products and services
principles.s2N5: Use of the system for personal gain outside agreed principles
principles.s3Intro: We recognise that mistakes, misunderstandings, and misuse may occur. If an issue is identified, the first step is always:
principles.s3Action: Where needed, participants may be asked to:
principles.s3Responsibility: This is part of Lana's principle of unconditional self-responsibility. Each participant remains free in their choices, and equally responsible for the consequences of those choices.
principles.s4Intro: If a serious issue is identified and responsibility is not yet taken, access to the Lana ecosystem may be temporarily suspended until the matter is resolved. This may include temporary suspension of:
principles.s4P4: Participation within the Lana shop and related services
principles.s4Restore: Access is restored once the matter has been addressed through the responsibility and correction process. Our focus is always restoration before exclusion.
principles.s4Repeated: Repeated or deliberate misuse may lead to permanent removal from the ecosystem.
principles.core: Freedom includes full ownership of consequences. Lana grows through trust. Trust grows through truth.
principles.closing: Thank you for being part of a living economy built on responsibility and mutual respect.

landing.recognitionBody: Someone asks where the honey is from, and you name the beekeeper, the meadow, the year. Your price is not the lowest and does not try to be. Whoever comes back, comes back for exactly that.
landing.abundanceBody: The Economy of Abundance is not just about selling goods — it is about giving the best of yourself into everything you create, grow or offer to the world. Every customer deserves the best of the best, and someone has to be the one who offers it.
landing.abundanceQuote: This page is for the people already doing that.
landing.twentyFigureNote: for you — and separately for your customers
landing.twentyBody: The customer pays the full price and that money is yours. The reward is added on top, never deducted: up to 20% for you, and separately up to 20% in LANA for your customer.
landing.twenty1Body: It is added to the full invoice and never taken out of it. It applies the same on euro payments, cash or card, and on LANA payments. You receive it to your bank account or in LANA, whichever you choose.
landing.twenty2Title: A bonus for your customers — up to 20%
landing.twenty2Body: A separate amount the customer receives in LANA, into their own wallet. It does not lower your price and does not come out of your till. It applies to purchases in euros; on a LANA payment there is no such bonus.
landing.twenty3Body: Your share comes out of the 120% an investor pays for the purchase through direct.lana.fund; whatever of that 20% you do not take goes to the caretaker who looks after your shop. The customer's bonus comes from Lana.Discount's wallet.
landing.twenty4Title: How the two percentages are set
landing.twenty4Body: You do not set the percentages yourself and they cannot be bought. LanaPays publishes them with its own key. A new shop starts at 5% and 5%, and 20% is a ceiling no record can exceed.
landing.moreTitle: Something more is not a slogan.
landing.moreBody: Local, organic, high quality, unique, kind to the environment — behind each of those words stands a real cost and a real decision. You know which one.
landing.more1Body: You chose the supplier, not a catalogue. You know their name, and you know what happens when they run out.
landing.more2Body: A slower process, a smaller batch, more work by hand. It shows in the price, and in what the customer takes home.
landing.more3Title: What you could have done more cheaply
landing.more3Body: Every time you chose the more expensive, the cleaner or the closer way, you paid part of it yourself. No price list shows that.
landing.more4Body: A provider is a living example of what they offer. People notice that before they look at the price.
landing.howBody: No terminal, no installation, no new device. You open mobile.lanapays.us in your browser and the till is ready.
landing.how1Body: Scan the QR code of your Lana key. It is used only inside your browser and never leaves your device. A session lasts eight hours.
landing.how2Body: Cash or card in your shop's currency, LANA in person at the counter, or a payment link you send to a customer who is not standing in front of you.
landing.how3Title: Photograph the receipt, if there is one
landing.how3Body: The photo is not required. If you take one, the AI reads the amount and the invoice number and fills them in for you; you can correct either, or type both by hand.
landing.how4Body: Scan the customer's QR, or tap a regular from your list. A brand-new customer can be registered right at the counter — you type their name and the sale carries on.
landing.currenciesBody: Your reward runs on both rails — on a purchase paid in euros and on a purchase paid in LANA. The customer's bonus is tied to money: they pay in euros and receive LANA into their wallet.
landing.cur1Body: The customer pays the way they always have, in cash or by card. A single invoice has a ceiling; anything above it is adjusted down rather than refused. A new shop starts with a modest monthly cash volume.
landing.cur2Body: The customer shows their key, the transaction is signed in the browser, and the LANA goes straight to the investor. You are paid for the goods by transfer, together with your reward. The monthly cash limit does not touch this rail, and there is no customer bonus on it.
landing.cur3Body: You issue the invoice in your own shop's currency; ten of them are accepted, from the euro to the convertible mark. The LANA rail also asks for your payout details on file — an IBAN or company information.
landing.keyBody: Your key is used only inside your browser and never leaves your device. When a customer pays in LANA, their transaction is signed right there — their key is never sent to any server.
landing.trustBody: Trust grows through truth. Everything recorded through Lana must reflect a real and honest exchange — real purchases, correct prices, genuine receipts. When something does go wrong, the first step is always a conversation; our focus is always restoration before exclusion.
landing.joinBody: When we ask how you support the Economy of Abundance, it is not a marketing question — it is an invitation to look deeper. When each one gives their best, together we build a world in which there is enough for everyone.
landing.join1Body: Who you are and what you offer. We will get in touch with you. This is not a self-serve sign-up and it is not instant.
landing.join2Body: As part of registering you write, in your own words, that you accept unconditional self-responsibility. No templates — you have to write it yourself.
landing.join3Body: Every shop has to be approved before the first sale can run on it. LanaPays sets the percentages and the monthly limits.
landing.footerAlready: Already have a key? Sign in above.
landing.heroLead: Up to 20% in rewards for you — and separately for your customers, on euro purchases too. On the phone you already carry.

directLana.reason.UNIT: this shop does not take LANA directly at the moment.
directLana.reason.WALLET: the shop's wallet is not its owner's valid Main Wallet. Fix it on shop.lanapays.us.
directLana.reason.PLAN: the payment could not be prepared. Try again.
directLana.reason.GENERIC: the payment could not be prepared.
directLana.reason.MARGIN_INVALID: the shop's margin cannot be read.
directLana.reason.RATE_UNAVAILABLE: there is no LANA price for this currency right now.
directLana.reason.RATE_CHANGED: the LANA price changed meanwhile. Try again.
directLana.reason.AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL: the amount is too small to pay in LANA.
directLana.reason.INVOICE_NUMBER_INVALID: the invoice number is not valid.
directLana.reason.INVOICE_USED: this invoice number is already paid in this shop.
directLana.reason.REGISTRAR_UNAVAILABLE: the wallet register could not be checked. Try again in a few minutes.
directLana.reason.PAYER_NOT_REGISTERED: the customer's card is not registered.
directLana.reason.PAYER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: this kind of wallet cannot pay directly.
directLana.reason.PAYER_OWNER_UNKNOWN: the owner of the customer's card could not be confirmed.
directLana.reason.SELF_PAYMENT: the shop's owner cannot pay their own shop.
directLana.reason.CHAIN_UNAVAILABLE: the LANA network could not be read from two servers. Try again.
directLana.reason.CHAIN_PENDING: the customer's wallet has a payment still waiting for a block. Try again after the next block.
directLana.reason.CARD_PAYMENT_PENDING: this card has a payment that is still being checked.
directLana.reason.SALE_PAYMENT_PENDING: a payment for this sale is still being checked.
directLana.reason.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: the card does not have enough confirmed LANA, network fee included.
directLana.reason.INPUT_LIMIT: the card holds too many small amounts for one payment. Pay with another card or in cash.
directLana.reason.WALLET_STATE_CHANGED: the card changed meanwhile. Try again.
directLana.reason.QUOTE_EXPIRED: the offer ran out. Scan the card again.
directLana.reason.DEVICE_CLOCK: this device's clock is wrong. Correct it and try again.
directLana.reason.NETWORK: the server could not be reached. Try again.
directLana.reason.WALLET_CHANGED: the shop's wallet changed meanwhile. Try again.
directLana.reason.RESEND_TOO_LATE: it is too old. Pay again with the same card while the customer is here.
directLana.reason.NOT_RECEIVED: the payment did not reach the server. Scan the card again.
directLana.resendRefused: The same payment was not sent again: {{reason}}
directLana.resendRefusedByNetwork: The network refused the same payment again. Until this is clear, do not take a second payment.
directLana.refusedSentText: The network refused the payment, but it was sent, so it may still go through. Until this is clear, do not take cash and do not scan another card.
directLana.unknownNoSecond: Do not take cash and do not scan another card.
directLana.previousStillChecked: The previous payment for this purchase is still being checked and may still go through. Do not take a second payment.
directLana.newSaleWarning: The payment of {{amount}} is still being checked and may still go through. Start a new payment only for another purchase, never for this one.
directLana.sendLinkHint: The customer pays from home, with their own card, straight into the shop's wallet.
directLana.linkPriceNote: The link fixes the invoice amount and the margin. The LANA are worked out when the customer pays, at the price of that moment.
directLana.linkRefused: The link could not be created: {{reason}}
directLana.cancelLinkConfirm: Cancel the payment link for {{amount}}? The customer will no longer be able to pay with it.
directLana.reason.INVOICE_HAS_LINK: this invoice number already has an open payment link.
directPay.title: LANA direct payment
directPay.priceNote: You get the exact LANA amount before you confirm, at the price of that moment. You pay the network fee.
directPay.enterKey: Scan or enter the private key (WIF) of your LANA card. The key never leaves this device.
directPay.directNote: The payment goes straight to the shop's wallet.
directPay.confirmText: You will pay {{lana}} LANA to {{name}} ({{wallet}}). The network fee is {{fee}} LANA. The payment cannot be undone.
directPay.sentText: Confirmation usually follows within a few minutes. If it is not confirmed, open this link again.
directPay.paidText: The payment is confirmed. The seller sees it at their till.
directPay.unknownText: The payment is being checked (usually a few minutes). Do not pay with another card or in another way.
directPay.resendHint: The same signed payment is sent, not a new one, so you cannot pay twice.
directPay.payAgain: Pay again with the same card
directPay.payAgainHint: This is not a second payment: it spends the same money from the card as the previous one, so only one of the two can go through.
directPay.refusedSentText: The network refused the payment, but it was sent, so it may still go through. Do not pay with another card until it is clear.
directPay.resendRefused: The same payment was not sent again: {{reason}}
directPay.resendRefusedByNetwork: The network refused the same payment again. Do not pay with another card until it is clear.
directPay.previousStillChecked: The previous payment of this link is still being checked and may still go through. Do not pay with another card.
directPay.notFound: This payment link cannot be found. Check the link.
directPay.expiredInfo: This payment link has expired. Ask the seller for a new one.
directPay.cancelledInfo: The seller cancelled this payment link.
directPay.closedInfo: This shop cannot take LANA direct payments at the moment.
directPay.addressNotKey: This is a wallet address, not a private key. To pay you need the private key (WIF) of your card.
directPay.reason.RATE_UNAVAILABLE: there is no LANA price for this currency right now. Try later.
directPay.reason.RATE_CHANGED: the LANA price changed meanwhile. Try again.
directPay.reason.AMOUNT_TOO_SMALL: the amount is too small to pay in LANA.
directPay.reason.INVOICE_USED: this invoice is already paid in this shop.
directPay.reason.REGISTRAR_UNAVAILABLE: the wallet register could not be checked. Try again in a few minutes.
directPay.reason.PAYER_NOT_REGISTERED: your card is not registered. You can register it at a LanaPays.Us till.
directPay.reason.PAYER_OWNER_UNKNOWN: the owner of your card could not be confirmed.
directPay.reason.PAYER_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: this kind of wallet cannot pay directly.
directPay.reason.SELF_PAYMENT: the shop's owner cannot pay their own shop.
directPay.reason.CHAIN_UNAVAILABLE: the LANA network could not be checked just now. Try again.
directPay.reason.CHAIN_PENDING: your wallet has a payment that is not confirmed yet. Try again in a few minutes.
directPay.reason.CARD_PAYMENT_PENDING: your card has another payment that is still being checked. Try once it is confirmed.
directPay.reason.SALE_PAYMENT_PENDING: another payment of this link is already being checked. Do not pay again.
directPay.reason.INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS: your card does not have enough confirmed LANA (network fee included).
directPay.reason.INPUT_LIMIT: your card has too many small amounts for one payment. Pay with another card.
directPay.reason.WALLET_STATE_CHANGED: your card changed meanwhile. Try again.
directPay.reason.WALLET_CHANGED: the shop's wallet changed meanwhile. Try again.
directPay.reason.QUOTE_EXPIRED: the offer ran out. Enter your key again.
directPay.reason.DEVICE_CLOCK: this device's clock is wrong. Correct it and try again.
directPay.reason.NETWORK: the server could not be reached. Try again.
directPay.reason.NOT_RECEIVED: the payment did not reach the server. Enter your key again.
directPay.reason.RESEND_TOO_LATE: it is too old. Pay again with the same card.
directPay.reason.UNIT: the shop cannot take LANA direct payments at the moment.
directPay.reason.PLAN: the payment could not be prepared. Try again.
directPay.reason.GENERIC: the payment could not be prepared.
directPay.reason.TOO_MANY_TRIES: there were too many tries for this link. Try again in a few minutes.
vault.unlockHint: Encrypted on this device only. Once unlocked it stays in this tab and is forgotten after 15 minutes without use.
vault.remove: Remove the saved key from this device
vault.removeConfirmText: To remove it, unlock it once more. Keep your key (card or paper) somewhere safe: without it you cannot sign in.
vault.orOtherKey: or sign in with a key
vault.saveHint: Next time you sign in with Face ID or your fingerprint, no card needed. The key is encrypted on this device only.
vault.noSaveHint: Not saved: the key stays only in this tab until you close it or sign out.
vault.methodPasskey: Passkey (Face ID, Touch ID, iCloud Keychain)
vault.newPassword: New password for the saved key
vault.passwordRule: At least 14 characters, not only digits. It cannot be recovered: if you forget it, sign in with your key again.
vault.lockedText: Your key is not in this tab any more (page reloaded, or 15 minutes without use).
vault.error.invalid_record: The saved key on this device is damaged. Sign in with your key again.
vault.error.invalid_key: That is not a valid private key.
vault.error.other_identity: The saved key belongs to someone else.
vault.error.password_weak: The password must have at least 14 characters and not only digits.
vault.error.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
vault.error.storage_refused: This browser does not allow saving (private mode?).
vault.error.already_saved: A key is already saved on this device. Remove it first, then save another.
vault.error.changed_elsewhere: The saved key was changed in another tab. Reload the page and try again.
vault.error.nothing_saved: No key is saved on this device.
vault.error.unlock_failed: Could not unlock: wrong password, or the passkey did not match.
vault.error.passkey_unavailable: This browser has no passkeys here. Choose a password instead.
vault.error.passkey_no_prf: This passkey cannot protect a key (no PRF). Choose a password instead.
vault.error.verify_failed: Saving could not be checked; nothing was saved.
vault.forgotHint: Forgot the password? Below, scan or type your key and tick “Save my key encrypted on this device” — the saved key is replaced.
vault.tapToSave: Tap “Sign in” to save your key with a passkey.
vault.notSaved: You are signed in, but your key was NOT saved on this device:
vault.error.device_failed: This device could not check the password just now (not enough memory). Close other tabs and try again, or sign in with your key below.
